name: chatgpt-plusplus
description: Tweak system for the OpenAI ChatGPT desktop app

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @chatgpt-plusplus/sdk && npm run build --workspace @chatgpt-plusplus/native-host && npm run build --workspace @chatgpt-plusplus/runtime && npm run build --workspace @chatgpt-plusplus/loader && npm run build --workspace chatgpt-plusplus
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @chatgpt-plusplus/sdk && npm run build --workspace @chatgpt-plusplus/native-host && node --import tsx --test packages/*/test/*.test.ts
